products.name: Soft Tones No. 1

images.alt: Soft Tones No. 1, a low arrangement in cream and pale green
Soft Tones No. 1 seen from the side

products.description: A low, wide composition built to sit on a dining table without interrupting a conversation across it. Cream and the palest green, held in a matte ceramic vessel.
products.composition: Artificial roses, ranunculus and eucalyptus in a matte ceramic vessel.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush. Keep out of direct sunlight to preserve the colour.
products.styling_notes: Sits well as a single centrepiece, or paired with No. 3 at either end of a long table.

products.name: Soft Tones No. 2

images.alt: Soft Tones No. 2, a structured box arrangement in white

products.description: The largest piece in the release. A structured, upright arrangement intended for an entrance table or a console where it can be seen from both sides.
products.composition: Artificial peonies, roses and dried grasses in a lined presentation box.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush. Keep out of direct sunlight to preserve the colour.
products.styling_notes: Reads best against a dark wall, where the pale palette separates cleanly from the background.

products.name: Soft Tones No. 3

images.alt: Soft Tones No. 3, a compact blush arrangement

products.description: The smallest of the three original pieces, and the one most often bought in pairs. Compact enough for a bedside table or a desk.
products.composition: Artificial garden roses and gypsophila in a small footed vessel.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush. Keep out of direct sunlight to preserve the colour.
products.styling_notes: Intended to be bought in twos. A single piece can look under-scaled on a large surface.

products.name: Soft Tones No. 4

images.alt: Soft Tones No. 4, a pale arrangement with gold detail

products.description: Warmer than the rest of the release. A soft oat palette lifted with a little antique gold, for rooms that need the neutral to carry some weight.
products.composition: Artificial roses, dried palm and preserved foliage in a footed brass vessel.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush. Polish the vessel with a dry cloth only.
products.styling_notes: The only piece in the release with a metallic. Best used alone rather than grouped.

products.name: Soft Tones No. 5

images.alt: Soft Tones No. 5, a rounded arrangement in blush and lilac

products.description: A rounded, generous form in blush and the faintest lilac. Made in the smallest run of the release.
products.composition: Artificial garden roses, hydrangea and lisianthus in a ribbed ceramic bowl.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush. Keep out of direct sunlight to preserve the colour.
products.styling_notes: Reads as one mass rather than individual stems. Give it space on either side.

products.name: Soft Tones No. 6

images.alt: Soft Tones No. 6, a small blush box arrangement

products.description: The gifting piece. Small, finished on all four sides, and sized to be carried by hand.
products.composition: Artificial roses and wax flower in a lidded gift box.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush. Keep the lid on when not displayed.
products.styling_notes: Photographs well with the lid resting beside it rather than closed.

products.name: Christmas No. 1

images.alt: Christmas No. 1, a deep red potted arrangement

products.description: A deep red potted arrangement built to sit on a hall table for the length of the season.
products.composition: Artificial roses, berried foliage and pine in a glazed pot.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush. Store flat in tissue between seasons.
products.styling_notes: Built to be stored and brought back out. The pine holds its shape if packed loosely.

products.name: Christmas No. 2

images.alt: Christmas No. 2, a small red and black box arrangement

products.description: A small, dark box arrangement for a desk or a guest room. Red against near-black rather than against green.
products.composition: Artificial roses and preserved foliage in a black lidded box.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush.
products.styling_notes: The darkest piece in the release. Needs a light surface underneath it.

products.name: Christmas No. 3

images.alt: Christmas No. 3, a blue and red arrangement

products.description: The departure from the season's usual palette: cold blue with red held back to an accent.
products.composition: Artificial roses, thistle and eucalyptus in a tall ceramic vase.
products.care_notes: Dust gently with a soft dry brush. Keep out of direct sunlight to preserve the colour.
products.styling_notes: Intended for people who do not decorate in red and green. Works past the season.

products.name: Sovereign
products.description: The collection's most expansive work. An architectural arrangement characterized by dramatic height and a wide, reaching silhouette. Dark, structured wrapping anchoring deep plum and ivory tones marks a presence both bold and grounded.

products.name: Aube de Soie
products.description: Light and ethereal. Layers of translucent white wrapping creating a sense of movement around a core of muted pastels. An effortless composition valuing negative space and a gentle, tonal aesthetic.

products.name: Noire Citron
products.description: A study in visual weight and contrast. Sharp, dark outer structure providing a crisp frame for a warm, luminous center of tonal yellows and soft pinks. Balanced composition wrapped in a delicate mesh that adds a layer of depth without compromising clean, modern lines.

products.name: Dentelle Classique
products.description: A focus on intricate detail and classic contrast. Veiled in a delicate lace-like mesh that softens the transition between a deep crimson center and dark outer wrap. Traditional in form but contemporary through a sharp use of color and texture.

products.name: Aria
products.description: A celebration of texture and detail. Layered mesh creating a voluminous, rounded base topped with an organic arrangement of pink tones. Subtle, fluttering accents providing a sense of narrative and movement.

products.name: Cœur
products.description:
A concentrated expression of devotion. Housed in a scarlet, heart-shaped case with gold accents, featuring a dense curation of rouge textures and tones. Includes a subtle storage element and gilded closure; a presence that feels both substantial and intimate.

• Height: 10 cm
• Length: 13 cm
• Vessel: Heart-shaped case with integrated storage

products.name: The Heirloom
products.description:
Defined by verticality and a sense of preservation. Housed within a clear cloche, featuring a central, tree-like form rising from a bed of deep rouge textures. Set upon a natural wood foundation; an enduring, sculptural object designed to sit quietly within a space.

• Height: 17 cm
• Base Diameter: 11.5 cm
• Vessel: Glass cloche with a natural wood base

products.name: Abundance
products.description: Expansive and layered composition featuring a central arrangement of soft, warm tones framed by a structural, fanned backdrop. Integrating illustrative accents and vibrant butterfly motifs to create a narrative-driven silhouette. Finished with architectural paper folds and gold-trimmed edges; a substantial presence designed as a comprehensive expression of gratitude.
